notes.title: Version 0.31
notes.content:
CAMPAIGNS
This patch is about upping the difficulty. Last patch, the early levels were too easy, so it wasn't necessary to try to pick a good build or aim well. For that reason, the chill difficulty without a timer has been removed.
New difficulty levels
Lite

Hardcore

Maximum
MISS LIMIT
Added a miss counter that has a default limit of 10. Miss too many times and you'll get a game over.
OBJECTIVES
Completion of level objectives now reduce the price of random upgrades.
METAPROGRESSION
There is a now a meta upgrade to increase the campaign time limit.

Meta upgrades base price is now $0 instead of $10
UPGRADES
Removed ball limit upgrade.

Added a ball limit prestige mechanic that increases the ball limit by 10 each time you reset.

Added a miss limit upgrade that increases the miss limit and resets the current misses.
